story: Label alignment becomes intermittently inconsistent after a roll change while bottle presentation variability is elevated.
truth_boundary: Scenario truth exists only to coordinate synthetic source outputs. It is not commissioned machine truth, OEM guidance, a diagnosis, or evidence about a physical machine.

design_assumptions.intent: Historical maintenance evidence is a first-class ranking input and is expected to become more valuable as the maintained history grows.

historical_evidence.summary: Four well-documented similar historical cases on this synthetic asset localized to bottle-presentation relationships; three required approved guide/presentation correction and none required a timing change.
historical_evidence.boundary: Historical pattern strongly informs ranking but does not prove the current root cause or current physical state.

deterministic_interpretation.summary: The verification run remains worse than the synthetic baseline and slightly better than the immediately preceding concern window.
deterministic_interpretation.bounded_finding: Alignment inconsistency persists while presentation-interval variability remains elevated relative to the synthetic baseline.
deterministic_interpretation.causality_boundary: Current coordinated signals plus strong similar CMMS history support prioritizing presentation-focused localization, but neither current nor historical evidence establishes the present root cause.

ranked_next_options.ranking_semantics: Current evidence alignment, historical CMMS support, and information value only. Rank is not root-cause probability, proof, authorization, or a safety determination.
basis: camera still shows an apparent skew event
presentation-interval variability remains elevated versus the synthetic baseline
line speed is unchanged across baseline, concern, and verification windows
four similar well-maintained CMMS cases localized to bottle-presentation relationships
three similar CMMS cases were resolved by approved guide/presentation correction
no similar historical case required a timing change

options.title: Inspect bottle presentation stability
options.rationale: Current operator, telemetry, camera, and quality evidence converges on the presentation relationship, and four similar well-documented CMMS cases on this synthetic asset localized to presentation stability.
options.historical_support: strong: 4/4 similar synthetic CMMS cases localized to presentation relationships
options.boundary: Inspect and localize only. Historical recurrence is not proof of the current cause. Any correction must come from commissioned procedure or qualified authority, then receive its own fresh bounded verification run.

options.title: Verify guide / spacing relationship
options.rationale: Current evidence does not directly isolate guide position, but three similar CMMS cases document approved guide/presentation corrections after comparable symptoms.
options.historical_support: strong: 3 similar synthetic cases involved guide/presentation correction
options.boundary: Verification is not permission to adjust. Historical success does not prove the same condition exists now. Any change requires commissioned procedure or qualified authority and a fresh trial.

options.title: Repeat the same-condition verification run
options.rationale: A repeat without material change still provides useful current-state repeatability evidence, but the strong maintained CMMS history now makes presentation-focused localization more informative first.
options.historical_support: neutral: history favors localization but does not remove the value of repeatability evidence
options.boundary: No material intervention is introduced. Run still requires site authorization and the same controlled test conditions.

options.title: Request an authorized reduced-speed diagnostic trial
options.rationale: A rate-sensitivity test may add information, but speed did not change when the concern appeared and three similar historical cases occurred at normal line speed.
options.historical_support: weakens rank: 3 similar synthetic cases occurred at normal line speed
options.boundary: This is a request for an authorized diagnostic trial, not an instruction to change speed.

options.title: Review label timing / peel geometry evidence
options.rationale: Current evidence points more strongly toward presentation stability, and none of the four similar synthetic CMMS cases required a timing change.
options.historical_support: deprioritizing: 0/4 similar synthetic cases required timing change
options.boundary: Deprioritized does not mean healthy. Historical absence is not proof and review does not authorize adjustment.

parameters_notice: All numeric values, historical records, and ranked options are synthetic scenario parameters chosen for internal consistency and demo readability. They are not OEM thresholds, commissioned limits, safe operating limits, production recommendations, or proof of root cause.
